modules.description: Follow Dynasty news and PFF-style performance grades. Add scouting fog, letter or word ratings, optional colors, and clearer money labels.
Fans arrive, leave, cheer and travel with the matchup. Tune crowd sound, camera shake, visiting support and replay options.
Set offensive and defensive play clocks, playcall limits and cooldowns. Each Dynasty keeps its own choices.
Practice full drives or play a scrimmage in Dynasty or main-menu Practice. Choose a starting spot, switch sides and check session stats.

pending: Exact compatibility across other game and overhaul versions

distribution.compatibilityNotes: Offline Dynasty, offline main-menu Practice, and basic offline Play Now atmosphere. Ace installed the final 1.0 build, restarted MMC and the game, and reported the fixes working. AIO 1.4.1 and its TeamBuilder patch have targeted adapters; unknown native programs are rejected. This is targeted live confirmation, not universal overhaul compatibility or an FPS benchmark. Updates are optional; retain save backups and your previous installer.
